Photosynthesis
Green plants make their own food in the leaves. Chlorophyll traps light energy from the sun.
The plant takes in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil.
Glucose is made, and oxygen is given out.
The equation is: carbon dioxide + water -> glucose + oxygen, using light energy and chlorophyll.
In an experiment, a leaf kept in the dark for 48 hours gave a negative starch test.
model_answer_with_placeholders: Wannan shafin ya tattauna yadda tsire-tsire masu launin kore ke samar da abincinsu a cikin ganyen su ta hanyar photosynthesis. Suna amfani da chlorophyll wajen kama makamashin hasken rana, suna daukar carbon dioxide daga iska da ruwa daga ƙasa. A sakamakon haka, ana samun glucose yayin da ake fitar da oxygen. An bayyana wannan tsari ta hanyar lissafin: carbon dioxide + ruwa -> glucose + oxygen, tare da amfani da makamashin hasken rana da chlorophyll. Gwajin gwaji ya nuna cewa ganye da aka ajiye a cikin duhu na tsawon ⟦N1⟧ bai nuna sakamakon starch ba, wanda ke nuni da cewa ba shi da photosynthesis.
